Name: FS - SH's Cottagecore Set
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: Adds multiple recolorable cottagecore-esque accessories, hats, shirts, skirts, and sleeves to your game via Fashion Sense framework
Description:
This has been sitting untouched in my laptop since November 2022, so it's about time I uploaded this! <3 Similar to my previous FS pack, Animal Stuff and More Accessories and Stuff, this pack aims to add more customizable parts for your player! This pack kind of follows a similar premise to my previous packs, wherein you can use each accessory to build your farmer's outfit.
There are currently over 50+ pieces for you to choose from (see images to know what are included in this FS pack), all recolorable. Although, these parts don't necessarily have to be used to make anything cottagecore-like. Do whatever you'd like and have fun with what your creativity comes up with!

**The sleeves work for both female and male farmer sprites (each accessory/sleeves have two versions each).**

![](https://imgur.com/OrH6e66.png)
As of version 1.1, there are _21 in the Hats category_, _10 in the Shirts category_, _7 in the Sleeves category_, _5 in the Pants category_ and __28 in the Accessories category__.

![](https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png)
[Link to frequently asked questions section](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2050)

![](https://imgur.com/lT7uwQV.png)
Mods used in the preview pictures:

*   [Dynamic Reflections](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12831)

*   [Fashion Sense](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969) example pack

I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle) ~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
